# Kehilat Shaare Shalom

> Kehilat Shaare Shalom is a Sephardic shul (synagogue) at 22 Andover Lane in Woodmere, NY, in the Five Towns on Long Island. Led by HaRav David Rubinoff, Shlita, it holds daily minyanim, Shabbat programs, and weekly Torah learning, and welcomes guests and new families from Woodmere, Cedarhurst, Lawrence, Hewlett, Inwood, and the wider Five Towns Jewish community.

Enter through the rear entrance. Minyan times change with the weekly bulletin, so the minyan schedule page is the source of truth for current times.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ksswoodmere.org/): Next minyan, regular Shacharit and Mincha & Arvit times, Shabbat programs, live Woodmere zmanim, and the Five Towns eruv map.
- [Minyan schedule](https://ksswoodmere.org/minyanim): Current weekday, Sunday, Shabbat, and holiday minyan times plus zmanim.
- [Community info](https://ksswoodmere.org/community-info): Torah classes, Kiddush and Seuda Shlishit, kids programming, Five Towns mikvah listings, directions, and FAQs for first-time visitors.
- [Support us](https://ksswoodmere.org/support-us): Donate by Zelle, sponsor a Kiddush, or dedicate Seuda Shlishit or Torah learning.

## Contact
